statement: SELECT concat(cast(date(window.start) as string),' drift_type=',drift_type,' ks=',cast(round(ks_test.statistic,3) as string),' ks_p=',cast(round(ks_test.pvalue,4) as string)) AS row FROM workspace.mlpab768409.prediction_log_drift_metrics WHERE column_name='prediction' AND drift_type='CONSECUTIVE' AND date(window.start) BETWEEN '2026-03-05' AND '2026-03-11' ORDER BY window.start
